title: Ducks on the water
prompt: Spot some ducks (or any waterbird) on a pond, river, or lake.
tips: Keep your distance and let them go about their day — don't chase or corner them for a photo.
Don't feed them unless it's permitted and you have food that's actually safe for them (bread isn't).
